svg.title: Azure cloud, client and Azure Local: connected platform architecture
svg.desc: A client browser and kubectl connect through a local Azure Arc proxy to the Azure Arc cloud service. Arc agents in an on-premises Kubernetes cluster initiate the outbound connection; an authenticated bidirectional session requires no inbound Internet firewall port. Foundry Local, Istio and certificate management are local platform components, not part of the Arc tunnel. The Azure Local multi-rack installation hosts the cluster, PDF assistant, local RAG data services and Qwen CPU inference. Approved ACR supplies images during provisioning. Official product artwork identifies Azure Arc, Foundry Local, Istio, Kubernetes, Azure Local and Azure Container Registry.
svg.text: Connected platform view / product icons, not a request-processing pipeline
On-premises datacenter / Azure Local multi-rack installation
Two-way traffic on the connected session
CPU-only Qwen2.5 0.5B / 14B; processing and data stay local
No inbound Internet firewall port for Arc access. Browser traffic crosses Azure; Foundry / Istio are not the access tunnel.
Product artwork: Microsoft Azure architecture icons and CNCF artwork. Generic client, datacenter and shield illustrations.
